pages.title: Welcome
pages.summary: This guide presents an original identity proposed for this project, with examples of its visual and editorial use.

examples.text: Negocio ficticio de ejemplo. Equipo, servicios, precios, horarios e imágenes ilustrativos
examples.title: Public disclosure

examples.text: Show that notice once on each website page in a readable footer. Do not present the example team or Bogotá setting as verified business facts.
examples.title: Disclosure placement

examples.text: Use this guide for Navaja & Roble only. No real homonymous business, official identity or external valuation is represented.
examples.title: Scope

pages.title: Index
pages.summary: Keep the guide in this sequence: identity, logo, typography, color, graphic language and applications. Use page numbers as quiet navigation rather than decorative labels.

examples.text: Cover, brand context, voice, signature, spacing and misuse.
examples.title: 01–15 · Identity and logo

examples.text: Typography, hierarchy, layouts, palette, icons and vector direction.
examples.title: 16–29 · Visual system

examples.text: Design studies for editorial formats, booking, private management and printed objects.
examples.title: 30–49 · Applications

pages.title: Defining
pages.summary: Build Espejo de oficio around one connected frame and its lower working edge. Discovery and booking share this structure; avoid split heroes, SaaS styling and repeated cards.

examples.text: A complete vector chair occupies the home mirror. Service selection and Reservar ahora begin exactly beneath the scene.
examples.title: One visual subject

examples.text: Chair and booking → services → horizontal ritual → shared team composition → Bogotá and example hours.
examples.title: One continuous story

pages.title: Vision & Mission
pages.summary: Treat vision and mission as project intentions, not corporate claims. The visual goal is composed craftsmanship; the experience goal is a clear, honest appointment journey.

examples.text: Express precision through connected edges, deliberate typography and restrained vector grain—not luxury superlatives.
examples.title: Visual intention

examples.text: Keep the chosen service recognizable from discovery through review and the persisted appointment result.
examples.title: Experience intention

pages.title: Brand Values
pages.summary: Use precision, restraint and cordiality as proposed design criteria. Express them through alignment, limited decoration and useful language, never unsupported claims about a real business.

examples.text: Corte · 45 min · $45.000 COP. Keep these three facts together wherever Corte is selected.
examples.title: Precision

examples.text: Use one Burgundy action on the working edge; leave the surrounding Bone surface quiet.
examples.title: Restraint

examples.text: No hay horas disponibles para esta selección. Puedes elegir otra fecha u otro barbero.
examples.title: Cordiality

pages.title: Tone of Voice
pages.summary: Write public copy in elegant, masculine and cordial Spanish. Use short sentences and direct actions; avoid macho exclusion, false heritage, testimonials and promises of real attendance.

examples.text: El oficio se nota. Elige tu servicio y consulta los horarios disponibles.
examples.title: Headline and invitation

examples.text: Revisa el celular. Debe tener 10 dígitos y comenzar por 3.
examples.title: Calm correction

examples.text: Aún no podemos confirmar el resultado. Recupera el estado de esta solicitud antes de intentar otra.
examples.title: Honest uncertainty

pages.title: Logo
pages.summary: Introduce the signature on Steel #A5AEAA, with the symbol on a Bone support surface. Present the business name in real typography, never embedded inside the symbol.

examples.text: Navaja & Roble
examples.title: Signature study

examples.text: One beveled frame. One restrained grain. A complete, readable name.
examples.title: Section opener

pages.title: Logo overview
pages.summary: The proposed signature combines the geometric bevel-and-grain symbol with a condensed typographic name. Keep the frame, inner grain and Burgundy working-edge marker intact.

examples.text: Place the symbol left of Navaja & Roble. Align the name optically with the symbol’s center, not its upper corner.
examples.title: Horizontal arrangement

examples.text: Center the symbol above Navaja & Roble on covers and signs. The name remains one readable line.
examples.title: Stacked arrangement

pages.title: Primary logo
pages.summary: Set Navaja & Roble in Barlow Condensed Semibold with its exact spelling, spaces and ampersand. Preserve live typography; do not replace the name with a descriptive heading.

examples.text: Navaja & Roble
examples.title: Primary signature

examples.text: Use a 32 px symbol beside a 24 px name in the compact header. Keep the navigation action outside the logo’s clear space.
examples.title: Header scale

examples.text: Keep the typographic ampersand legible. The separate bevel-and-grain symbol carries the custom geometry.
examples.title: Ampersand treatment

pages.title: Logo Safezone
pages.summary: Define x as one quarter of the symbol width. Leave at least x clear around a lockup and between symbol and name; measure from visible geometry, not the SVG canvas.

examples.text: At 32 px symbol width, reserve at least 8 px clear space. Do not let the menu icon enter this area.
examples.title: Compact header

examples.text: At 16 mm symbol width, keep 4 mm clear around the full lockup, including below the name.
examples.title: Printed signature

pages.title: Color combinations
pages.summary: Keep the original multicolor symbol on a Bone support surface in colored applications. Use Ink text on Bone or Steel, and Bone text on Ink or Burgundy.

examples.text: Ink field, Bone title, Bone symbol support. Do not invert individual pieces of the symbol.
examples.title: Dark cover

examples.text: Steel field, Ink name, Bone support behind the complete mark.
examples.title: Steel logo study

examples.text: Reservar ahora uses Bone text on Burgundy. Avoid Steel lettering on the light background.
examples.title: Primary action

pages.title: Brandmark
pages.summary: Use the supplied original SVG geometry as the shared symbol source. Its connected beveled frame and two angular grain paths represent Espejo de oficio, not an initial or barber-pole cliché.

examples.text: Use the symbol alone for the favicon and avatar when Navaja & Roble is named in the surrounding interface.
examples.title: Standalone use

examples.text: Keep the full 160 × 160 viewBox and proportional scaling. Never crop the lower Burgundy marker to make the symbol fit.
examples.title: Small reproduction

pages.title: Logo misuse
pages.summary: Do not stretch, rotate, outline, shadow or fragment the signature. Keep grain subordinate to the frame and never add neon, crossed razors or invented establishment dates.

examples.text: NAVAJA Y ROBLE changes the name. Always retain Navaja & Roble.
examples.title: Incorrect

examples.text: A Burgundy symbol directly on Burgundy disappears. Restore the Bone support surface instead of recoloring the geometry.
examples.title: Incorrect

examples.text: Do not add “Desde 1985”, “La mejor de Bogotá” or certification badges.
examples.title: Incorrect

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use condensed headings for presence and open body typography for clarity. Keep sentence case, compact headline leading and generous reading space; avoid ornamental capitals.

examples.text: Elige tu servicio. Consulta la disponibilidad y revisa tu cita de ejemplo.
examples.title: El oficio se nota

examples.text: Barlow Condensed carries the headline; Source Sans 3 carries the explanation, labels and actions.
examples.title: Two-family rule

pages.title: Typography overview
pages.summary: Use Barlow Condensed and Source Sans 3 from the supplied distributable font resources. Both families have supplied 400, 500, 600 and 700 weights; do not introduce a third display face.

examples.text: Consulta duración, precio de ejemplo y horarios antes de reservar.
examples.title: Un servicio, todos los detalles

examples.text: If font loading fails, use sans-serif without changing content or shrinking controls. The fallback is not the intended brand typography.
examples.title: Fallback treatment

pages.title: Primary typeface
pages.summary: Set primary headings in Barlow Condensed Semibold at 72 px desktop and 44 px phone, with approximately 1.0 line height. Keep the headline above the complete scene.

examples.text: Corte, barba y afeitado tradicional en una experiencia de ejemplo.
examples.title: El oficio se nota

examples.text: Use a short, deliberate line above the mirror. On narrow screens, wrap naturally rather than compressing or clipping the letters.
examples.title: Heading measure

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use upright styles: Barlow Condensed 600 for signature headings; Source Sans 3 400 for reading, 500 for labels and 600 for actions. Reserve 700 for compact emphasis, not the main hero.

examples.text: Comprueba el servicio, el barbero y el horario antes de guardar.
examples.title: Revisa tu cita

examples.text: Set “Corte + barba” in 600 and its explanatory sentence in 400. Do not simulate bold or use italics as a status signal.
examples.title: Weight distinction

examples.text: A compact “Horario actualizado” may use 700. Keep the adjoining explanation regular to preserve hierarchy.
examples.title: Strong emphasis

pages.title: Supporting type
pages.summary: Use Source Sans 3 for body text, prices, forms and schedules. Body and fields stay at least 16 px, navigation and buttons 14 px, and auxiliary text 12 px.

examples.text: Los horarios se muestran en hora de Bogotá.
examples.title: Elige una hora

examples.text: Keep “09:00–10:15”, “75 min” and “$65.000 COP” unbroken. Use tabular numerals in the owner’s agenda.
examples.title: Numeric clarity

pages.title: Hierarchy
pages.summary: Use one page heading, clear section headings and one dominant action per stage. Pair service name, duration and price before secondary explanation; never make auxiliary notes compete with results.

examples.text: Revisar reserva → service specification → Reservar cita de ejemplo → Editar selección.
examples.title: Hierarchy specimen

examples.text: Cita de ejemplo guardada comes before the code and management actions. Version details belong in a secondary disclosure.
examples.title: Result hierarchy

pages.title: Layouts
pages.summary: Use an 8 px spacing scale and a shared working edge. Keep full vector contours visible; at narrow widths reduce gaps, not type size, and place controls below rather than over the scene.

examples.text: Elige servicio, barbero, fecha y hora.
examples.title: Tu próxima cita

examples.text: At 1440 px, center the dominant mirror. At 768 px, use a 280 px scene beside flexible controls; date and personal fields follow below.
examples.title: Desktop and tablet

examples.text: Budget about 52 px navigation, 44 title, 120 complete scene, 76 selection/action and 220 initial controls. Keep date and next time visible.
examples.title: 390 × 640 composition

pages.title: Colors
pages.summary: Use Bone as the main canvas, Ink for reading and Burgundy for action. Steel and Oak articulate the mirror; keep large colored areas purposeful rather than alternating every section.

examples.text: Bone page → Oak mirror edge → Steel bevel → Burgundy selection marker.
examples.title: Palette rhythm

examples.text: Use a Burgundy field with a Bone heading and one quiet frame detail, not a full palette mosaic.
examples.title: Chapter divider

pages.title: Colors overview
pages.summary: Preserve all supplied hex values. Semantic roles are Bone background, Steel surface, Burgundy accent, Ink text and Oak muted detail. Success is an additional state token, never a replacement brand color.

examples.text: Bone #F2EFE8 · Steel #A5AEAA · Burgundy #743746
examples.title: Core tokens

examples.text: Ink #201D1B · Oak #725039. Use Oak sparingly for frame structure and secondary detail.
examples.title: Reading and structure

examples.text: Success #28604B accompanies “Guardado” and a check icon. Meaning must remain clear without color.
examples.title: Saved state

pages.title: Using Tints
pages.summary: Keep semantic tokens at their exact values. Optional tints belong only in quiet decorative fields; never fade body copy, selected controls, focus indicators or the original symbol.

examples.text: Use a light Oak-over-Bone decorative grain behind an empty area, with no text crossing it.
examples.title: Subtle grain

examples.text: Do not signal “No disponible” with faded Steel text. Use readable Ink wording and a distinct noninteractive treatment.
examples.title: Readable states

examples.text: Keep text at WCAG AA contrast and control boundaries at least 3:1. Steel is a surface or line, not small text on Bone.
examples.title: Contrast pairing

pages.title: Graphic Elements
pages.summary: Construct scenes entirely with CSS and original SVG. Join Oak uprights and crossbars, add a Steel bevel and restrained grain, and keep the lower working edge solid and unobstructed.

examples.text: Show a complete chair with rectangular back, curved arms and circular base. Keep every contour inside the connected frame.
examples.title: Hero scene

examples.text: Move the edge indicator for 280 ms as the service reference and facts update together. Keep focus on the selected control.
examples.title: Selection movement

examples.text: Apply final states immediately. Remove indicator travel and ritual reveals without removing selection or status feedback.
examples.title: Reduced motion

pages.title: Icons
pages.summary: Separate service references from utility icons. Give each service a stable SVG silhouette; tools illustrate only the ritual. Utility icons use consistent strokes and always retain accessible labels.

examples.text: Corte: side-part profile. Barba: defined jaw contour. Corte + barba: both features. Afeitado: reclined face with folded towel.
examples.title: Service silhouettes

examples.text: Pair the copy icon with “Copiar código”, the calendar with “Fecha” and a check with “Guardado”.
examples.title: Utility labels

examples.text: Show the selected service name and “Referencia visual no disponible” inside the same frame. Keep valid booking actions available.
examples.title: Missing reference

pages.title: Vector imagery
pages.summary: Replace the photography chapter with deliberate vector art direction. Use no raster imagery, stock interiors or simulated photographs; portraits must read as graphic fictional characters.

examples.text: Place Tomás, Julián and Samuel on one shared crossbar. Distinguish their bust silhouettes without implying photographic likeness.
examples.title: Team composition

examples.text: Arrange vector tools along a horizontal Oak line. Use the tools to explain sequence, never as substitutes for selected service profiles.
examples.title: Ritual composition

pages.title: Moodboard
pages.summary: Build the moodboard from internal ingredients: beveled geometry, abstract grain, condensed type and quiet steel surfaces. Avoid borrowed brand imagery, neon and fabricated vintage history.

examples.text: Bone plane, connected Oak frame, Steel inset and a restrained Burgundy working-edge marker.
examples.title: Espejo de oficio

examples.text: Pair “El oficio se nota” with a complete graphic chair and a generous blank margin—not distressed paper or gold ornament.
examples.title: Editorial character

pages.summary: Design study for /reservar: keep one continuous form with visible labels and 44 px targets. Service, barber, date and time precede name and mobile; Revisar stays activatable for validation.

pages.title: Appointment reminder card
pages.summary: Design study: replace a rewards card with a noncommercial appointment note. Use writable fields and the shared frame; introduce no points, stamps, membership tiers or discounts.

brandbook.voice: Español elegante, masculino y cordial, sin solemnidad excesiva. Frases breves y concretas; «El oficio se nota» como declaración principal. Acciones directas, errores serenos y estados honestos. Sin credenciales, testimonios ni promesas de atención real.
brandbook.positioning: Barbería clásica ficticia de Bogotá para quienes aprecian precisión, ritual y una reserva clara. Identidad de demostración original; servicios, equipo, precios y horarios son ejemplos suministrados, no hechos verificados de un establecimiento real.
